title: Weekly marketing report
summary: Each week, compares marketing metrics with the week before, audits a few key pages, and flags big moves.

inspiration.title: AI marketing report (GA, Google Ads, Meta Ads)
On-page SEO audit of any website

stages.title: Pick the dates
stages.does: Works out the last completed Monday to Sunday week and the week before it, so both sources use the same dates.

stages.title: Read both weeks
stages.does: Runs one read-only Google Analytics report and two read-only Search Console queries, for the two weeks from the windows stage, and saves the responses.

stages.title: Split the weeks
stages.does: Turns the analytics report into this-week.json and last-week.json, so no figure is the model's arithmetic.

stages.title: Add Search Console
stages.does: Adds the two Search Console responses to this-week.json and last-week.json under the search source, so no figure is the model's arithmetic.

stages.title: Compare weeks
stages.does: Computes the change per source and metric, so no figure is the model's arithmetic.

stages.title: Audit key pages
stages.does: Opens each page to audit and notes visible issues.

stages.title: Learn
stages.does: Turns feedback on earlier runs into learning and proposals before the write.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py learn --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out learn

stages.title: Write
stages.does: Applies the run input under the write contract.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py write --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out batches

connectors.label: Google Analytics (GA4)
connectors.purpose: Run one read-only report comparing this week with last week.
connectors.connect: Connect a Google Analytics 4 connector that can run reports, for example the Composio Google Analytics tools or Google's analytics-mcp server. Whether either can be limited to read-only is unverified, so the prompt restricts the run to report tools. RoutineOS does not supply one.

connectors.label: Google Search Console
connectors.purpose: Run two read-only search analytics queries, one per week, for the clicks, impressions, click rate and average position of one site.
connectors.connect: Connect a Google Search Console connector that can run search analytics queries, for example the Composio Google Search Console tools. Whether it can be limited to read-only is unverified, so the prompt restricts the run to query and read tools. RoutineOS does not supply one.

connectors.label: Web fetch
connectors.connect: Nothing to connect when the run can already open web pages.
